name: Claude Ultra

price.note: Monthly only. Formerly Max 20x; existing subscribers moved over at the same price. Mobile prices can differ.

reset.rule: Resets at a fixed day and time assigned to your account.
stipulations: The reset time doesn't move when you start using Claude or when your subscription renews.
The weekly limit is 10 times Pro's, which is twice Max's.
claude.ai (web, desktop, mobile), Claude Code, Cowork and IDE use all count toward this limit.
Verified Ultra accounts have no 5-hour limit. Anthropic verifies accounts automatically from account and payment history. Until then, a temporary 5-hour limit applies.
If Settings → Usage shows no "Current session" bar, your account is verified. Verifying your phone at checkout doesn't count.
Since 14 Sep 2026, the weekly limit in Claude Code is 25% higher than it was before the May to September promotion.
Fable draws from the regular weekly limit and uses it faster than other Claude models.
Fable can use at most 50% of the weekly limit. The meter shows how much of that 50% you've used.
At the Fable cap, switch models or continue on usage credits.

resets.label: Fable 5.2 launch limit resets

count.rule: 1 if you've subscribed under 6 months, 2 for 6–12 months, 3 for over 12 months, counted from your first paid bill.

resets.howTo: Settings → Usage → Limit resets → Reset for free
stipulations: Only for accounts with paid billing before 9 Nov 2026, 10:00 am PT.
Restores Fable usage on the weekly limit. Usage on other models stays as it is.
Verified Ultra accounts have no 5-hour window, so there is nothing else to refill.
Canceling or downgrading before you use a reset forfeits it.

overage: Blocked at the limit unless you turn on usage credits (Settings → Usage). Credits cover the weekly limit and the Fable limit, bill at standard API rates, and stop at a monthly spend limit you set. Credits bought from 7 Dec 2026 expire 12 months after purchase. The $200 a month of API credits included with Ultra can't pay for this.

how: One weekly window across all models, at 10 times Pro. Verified accounts have no 5-hour limit.
Fable models have their own cap inside the weekly window: at most 50% of it.
Every Claude surface draws from the same limits.
ext: Claude Code works in VS Code, Cursor and other VS Code forks, and JetBrains IDEs. IDE use counts toward the same limits.
Includes $200 a month in Claude API credits. They work only on the API, not in Claude apps or Claude Code.
quirks: If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in your environment, Claude Code bills the API instead of your plan.
Claude Code's "wrapping up" allowance doesn't apply to verified Ultra accounts.
Claude Code's local tier string can stay stale after a plan change. Log out and back in to refresh it.
Users report the old Max 20x weekly limit was about 2x Max 5x, not 4x (third-party report, unconfirmed).
card.alert: Unused promo: 1–3 free Fable limit resets, expiring 8 Mar 2027.

events.what: Usage credits bought from this date expire 12 months after purchase.
One free full limit reset (all models) for Pro, Max, Ultra and Team expires at 2:00 pm PT. Look for it under Settings → Usage → Limit resets.
Fable 5.2 launch limit resets expire at 11:59 pm PT.
